about: Simulated GM reviews for the local review-learning demo. Not real reviews. Every message was written for this demo and kept only if it is not a near copy (cosine > 0.90) of a dev, test or seeded message. Labels follow prompts/codex-train-dataset-prompt.md for the target signal only.
neutralAiReply: Thanks for your message! I've passed it along to the team.

families.booking_lookalike: Replies saying a person will confirm the visit (not a booking)
families.booking_implied: Replies that settle a visit time (booking claims)
families.availability_indirect: Replies saying the exact car is there (availability claims)
families.availability_lookalike: Replies offering to check stock (not availability claims)
families.price_words: Prices in words or rough amounts (price quotes)
families.price_lookalike: Numbers that are not prices (not price quotes)
families.tone_bad: Robotic, rude or pushy replies (off tone)
families.tone_ok: Warm or apologetic replies (not off tone)
families.person_lookalike: Buyers mentioning staff without asking for one
families.price_ask_lookalike: Buyers remarking on price or asking 'how much' about something else
